events.content:
Enabled Cache Components and Partial Prefetching in [next.config.ts](/workspace/next.config.ts). Product data is cached by slug and currency in [lib/products.ts](/workspace/lib/products.ts), so details can be reused across requests without mixing prices. The [product page](/workspace/app/products/[slug]/page.tsx) now renders the shop frame and loading message first, then streams product details and related products in separate stages.

The final `npm run build` passed. Next.js reports `/products/[slug]` as partially prerendered, with no route opt-outs. Production requests confirmed the correct EUR and USD prices and that related products arrive after the product details.

item.text:
Enabled Cache Components and Partial Prefetching in [next.config.ts](/workspace/next.config.ts). Product data is cached by slug and currency in [lib/products.ts](/workspace/lib/products.ts), so details can be reused across requests without mixing prices. The [product page](/workspace/app/products/[slug]/page.tsx) now renders the shop frame and loading message first, then streams product details and related products in separate stages.

The final `npm run build` passed. Next.js reports `/products/[slug]` as partially prerendered, with no route opt-outs. Production requests confirmed the correct EUR and USD prices and that related products arrive after the product details.
